base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production full-body playable character cutout for DARKNESS TOWER dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its premium detailed pixel-art RPG craftsmanship, not its lineup or multiple subjects. Draw exactly ONE class character described below (only Beastmaster may have its specified wolf, Puppeteer its specified dolls). STYLE: exquisite high-detail pixel art, crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, selective pixel outlines, rich limited color ramps and intricate pixel-shaded fabric/metal/leather, clear dimensional lighting, subtle cool rim and warm highlights. Adult believable heroic proportions and highly readable silhouette. Not flat SVG, not low-poly, not smooth painted art, not chibi. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha, no scene, no ground plane, no text, no labels, no frame, no watermark. Composition: centered full body in a square canvas, feet aligned near 90% canvas height, entire head, fingers, shoes, cape and every weapon tip visible with at least 6% empty margin; character fills most canvas height. Full anatomical coherence, two arms and two legs per human, exactly five fingers per hand, believable grip and functional equipment. Each character must be individually designed, never a recolored mannequin. Subject:
